scientific_integrity: The general theorem is proved by incidence counting and an explicit simplicial cocycle; finite experiments are checks, not infinite proof. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple strongly regular graphs with (lambda,mu)=(0,2) and k>=4; the cohomology claim is nonvanishing, not a full homotopy classification. Exhaustive finite verification only for the Clebsch instance. A closely relevant 2026 paper on the VC dimension of strongly regular graphs was available only through abstract-level comparison, leaving a priority risk.
title: A universal open-and-closed shattering law for triangle-free strongly regular graphs of codegree two
